title: Mapping Toxic Comments Across Demographics: A Dataset from German Public Broadcasting
benchmark_measurement: Detection of toxic speech targeted at religion, as part of a broader multi-label toxicity classification schema.
findings: Religious hate speech was found to be more prevalent among older users. It was entirely absent in the 0-30 age group but reached 1.94% in the 35+ age group, suggesting age is a significant factor in the expression of religious hate.
